review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision case. The original PRD preserves REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, and DEC-001, explicitly leaves the caller-visible rejection type unresolved, and prohibits generating assignable tasks before resolution. Accordingly, blocked readiness, requirement-decision-pending on DEC-001, evidence through repository/requirements/decisions, and empty task and assignment expectations are appropriate. The decision gate precedes Scenario Coverage, so the empty team and absence of an independent Reviewer do not introduce an earlier blocking prerequisite. The complete implementation-owner evidence supports source/index.ts and source/options.ts as the binding owner set; test files are verification scope, and the build configuration supports treating dist declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. The supplied nz implementation establishes discovery and compiler checking of test-d files despite the production tsconfig including only source; runtime tests alone are not type-checking evidence. Truncated runtime-test excerpts do not prevent establishing this decision-stage expectation. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation source digest domains, PRD trimming, project-scoped capability projection, and bundled prompt fingerprint. Model, sampling, policy, and budget identifiers are consistently frozen. Historical project reuse is not treated as capability evidence or candidate evidence, and no hypothetical input is treated as a human Decision. This approval concerns expectation coherence, not execution readiness or human attestation. I reviewed only the supplied data, did not execute code or independently recompute digests, and relied on the stated Service binding of fingerprints to saved inputs.
